messages:
zoe: Quick note — staging shows p99 spike when agents omit coalesce-handshake.
sam: repro?
zoe: Short requests (<=50ms) get batched into default 120ms window when header missing.
ravi: That's because deadline_hint is treated as absent; we also skip KV pin which causes headroom misaccounting under bursts.
marta: Proposal: add a tiny ingress normalizer that (1) synthesizes a conservative deadline_hint = min(tenant_min_slo,75ms) when missing, (2) marks kv_reserved=false, (3) sets handshake_source=synthetic so telemetry can split.
sam: Telemetry: counters enqueue.normalized, enqueue.synth_deadline, enqueue.kv_no_reserve; add response header X-RW-Compat: synthesized_deadline for customer visibility.
ravi: Tests: unit coverage for normalizer + perf integ that mixes legacy agents (10%) at scale to validate no headroom overcommit and tail latency behavior.
zoe: Rollout: start metrics-only for 24h; if per-tenant synthesized fraction >1% enable synth for that tenant with gradual ramp; if >5% sustained for 30m auto-enable microwindow policy for 10m.
marta: Important constraint: do NOT change required Enqueue proto fields; use optional headers and server-side normalize only. Hosted agents must remain compatible.
infra-bot: CI job queued: eng-runtime/compat-normalizer (unit + smoke perf). :robot_face:
zoe: I'll open the PR for the normalizer + telemetry and link it here when ready.
